buyer: controller or CFO of a multi-location operator

pilot_after_fit.condition: only after the diagnostic passes an agreed binary replay suite

effect_contract.permitted: one synthetic controller approval request for a matched fixture

acceptance: the same input produces the same decision
a duplicate replay creates no second approval request
a crash after durable intent can retry to exactly one approval request
a crash after durable intent can roll back before any approval request
missing or mismatched data fails before effect
every run emits a copyable JSON and Markdown receipt
